summary.text: Glen Meyer is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 17, serving since 2024. His committee assignments are Education, Health and Human Services, and State-Tribal Relations.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Meyer was born March 14, 1951, in Wayne and graduated from Pender High School in 1969.
His biography lists his occupation as retired farmer and businessman, and past service on the Thurston County Board of Supervisors and the School District 25 board.
It lists him as married to Lorie Habrock since June 6, 1980, with three children.
